rule.row_set: V64 T1 rows with V51 pv > 1.15 v_cut, outside the official T2 blackouts (= V59_loc row set) and real-frame cnt >= 5; only speed_kmh changes

candidates.C2: wide+vband: v' = clip(v64 + x1'b1 + x2'b2, 5, 120.75), x2 = 18 speed band means + const, b2 on the in-sample stage-1 residual

rule.fit: per month, OLS pooled over the 10 corridors, hide cells free & cnt >= 5, target ov - v64; evaluation odd/even-day cross-fit; apply all days
rule.choice: C2 if C2 passes G1-G3 and in both months dS(C2)-dS(C1) >= 5e-5 and dE_est(C2) <= dE_est(C1); else C1 if C1 passes G1-G3; else not built.  G4 failure: C2 -> C1 if C1 passed G1-G3 (re-check G4); else not built
rule.addon: after CM on the same row set: v <= 101.2 on the train-cap-101.2 links; v >= q/k_jam where q/v > k_jam (the 7 V64 rows with q/v > k_jam are outside R and stay unchanged)
rule.never: public LB, Task 2 data other than the public blackout flag, other-month data

note: written before any check run of this script; the rule is also in the docstring
